resources.string: For a watch that restarts over and over after a watch face. The phone waits for the watch and sends one command the moment it can, on every restart, until it lands.
This phone has no key for your watch

Rescue needs the key this app saves the first time it reads the watch or installs a face. Without it the watch would ask for a confirmation on its screen, which a stuck watch can\'t show. Try the phone that installed the face, or the fmc.tools rescue page in the browser that installed it.
Keeps only the built-in faces the watch last reported and shows the first one. Your data stays. Not yet tried on a stuck watch.
Erases everything on the watch and restarts it.
Switch to a stock face (Watch 3 Pro)

For a Watch 3 Pro on firmware 1.0.1.77: the watch forgets its installed faces and starts on a built-in one. No key needed, nothing is erased. Not yet confirmed on a real watch: keep this screen open and the phone next to the watch for a few minutes, then copy the log.
Keep this screen open and the phone next to the watch.
The watch keeps only its built-in faces.
All data on the watch is erased. This can\'t be undone.
Sent. The watch should restart clean. If it still restarts in a loop, start again.
Done. The watch kept only its built-in faces.
The watch refused the key this app has: it was paired again since. Rescue can\'t go on without a confirmation on the watch.
Material You: colours from your wallpaper, bigger type and softer shapes, like Android 17 on a Pixel.
